## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre completed 75 captures during July 2025. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists managed as scheduled apart from routine leave. The available activity records indicate that the site maintained its planned service delivery throughout the month. The total of 75 captures represents all images recorded during the reporting period and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

Of the 75 captures, 8 were ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 10.7. These captures could not be used for grading. The ungradable results are reported separately from the graded images to support monitoring of image quality and the completeness of the assessment process. The rate should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for July 2025.

## Grading

Grading identified 18 referable results from the captures assessed. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the typical interval from image capture to completion of grading was 1 day. Results requiring referral were recorded within the month’s grading activity, while the ungradable captures were excluded from grading because they could not be assessed. Overall, the report records activity, image-quality outcomes and grading results for Hill Counties Health Centre in July 2025.
